name: base
purpose: regular 20 ns clock; vin steps between samples, slow ramps and a negative excursion; a three-sample reset while vin steps; a short rst pulse that covers no sample
netlist:
simulator lang=spectre
global 0

ahdl_include "dut.va"

Vvin (vin 0) vsource type=pwl wave=[0 0 135.5n 0 136.5n 0.8 300n 0.8 380n 0.3 461.5n 0.3 462.5n 0.9 600n 0.9 601n -0.5 700n -0.5 760n 0.5 820n -0.2 857.5n -0.2 858.5n 0.7 950n 0.7 951n 0 1000n 0 1100n 1 1200n 1]
Vclk (clk 0) vsource type=pulse val0=0 val1=0.9 period=20n width=9.9n delay=9.95n rise=100p fall=100p
Vrst (rst 0) vsource type=pwl wave=[0 0 451.95n 0 452.05n 0.9 512.95n 0.9 513.05n 0 852.95n 0 853.05n 0.9 866.95n 0.9 867.05n 0 1200n 0]

XDUT (vin clk rst out) ct_lowpass_sampler

simulatorOptions options reltol=1e-6 vabstol=1e-8 iabstol=1e-12
tran tran stop=1200n maxstep=50p strobeperiod=50p errpreset=moderate strobeoutput=strobeonly
save vin clk rst out
